answer: Weight needs one peer-reviewed paper under the verified name. The journal confirms the author institutionally, two reviewers test methods and data, and the paper is indexed by DOI; one paper backs one identity, and repeat claims merge. A saffron trial counts only after review. Each fake costs one paper: 1,200 units and 180 days, and a gale-season trial cannot be bought shorter. 100 fakes cost 120,000 units and 100 reviews. Paper-mill text fails plagiarism checks, and each dataset is sealed with a cipher key tied to the author, so copied data exposes the cluster and retraction revokes it.
